title: [DECISION] fget refcount protection on ikm_fd prevents use-after-free
description: src/cdev/crypto2dev_fd.c lines 1791-1800: ikm_fd is passed to fget() immediately, which increments the file's refcount. The fd remains open (not closeable by userspace) until fput() at line 1826. This prevents the ikm_fd from being closed and its KEY fd state freed mid-operation. Without the refcount hold, userspace could close(ikm_fd) after passing it to DO_KDF but before the kernel reads the key material, causing use-after-free. The pattern is: fget() → acquire ks->lock → read key material → release ks->lock → fput(). This is the standard kernel pattern for fd passing between ioctls, but it is non-obvious that fget() is the safety mechanism. A less careful implementation might not hold the refcount while accessing the fd's private_data.
